name: OMPxContract treasury-inventory mispricing
summary: getBuyBackPrice divides the contract's ETH reserve by token.totalSupply() although the contract held most of that supply as unsold inventory, so purchase() sold inventory below its reserve share and buyBack() redeemed it at the full per-supply price; a flash-loaned purchase/buyBack loop drained the reserve.
notes: The verified non-proxy runtime was created in its deployment transaction and remained byte-identical through the exploit.
Loss is the contract's net ETH outflow in the anchor and two copycat purchase/buyBack loops by other senders (next block, and December 2025), found by campaign.mjs; flash-loan principal is excluded.
